the structure of the blogosphere, the social network of blogs, as it has evolved over time, as well as with the structure of individual blogs and how it has evolved over the lifetime of each blog.

blogging is not just a fad, but rather an important new form of communication.

the structure of blogspace is a complex mixture of social and content-related factors, and that it is constantly changing.
